validation.exact_attribution: 72 unique valid MP4 byte sequences returned in reversed completion order match their original scenes across 12 isolated account sessions.
validation.preparation: At most three accounts prepared concurrently; per-account duplicate preparation, generation during preparation, and session mutations protected; preference writes serialized.
validation.probe_recovery: Slow sibling page creation settles before any probe closes; unauthenticated worker sessions fall back and complete all ten scenes sequentially on Windows.
validation.direct_concurrency: Explicit worker checks still refresh service-created conversations, detect shared histories, preserve ten independent requests and isolate cancellation.
validation.resource_limits: Only twelve pages for twelve shared-chat accounts; no extra worker pages. Six download/decoder slots are independent from remote generation capacity. Offscreen cards retained in DOM; lazy images; video preload none.
validation.media_recovery: Native image/player sources preferred over invalid sandbox links; source child read; extensionless real downloads retained; account-session download recovers deliberately broken page fetch; unsupported media-only links report a concrete error.
validation.replies: Completed unlabelled confirmations/refusals do not wait to the generation timeout; active generation acknowledgements retained. Reply preview and status TXT available while running; URLs and emails redacted.
validation.packaged_executable: Standalone EXE startup; ten overlapping images despite deliberately failing loopback global fetch; saved directories, numbering and exact TXT names persist after restart; ten shared-chat videos with six simultaneous generations; explicit concurrency rejection completes all ten serially; native media fetch recovery rerun on packaged EXE.
validation.preserved_features: All TXT/SRT prompts and names, account choices and overrides, individual proxies/IP, session persistence, image-to-video, cancellation and renderer recovery.
validation.limitation: All automated generation tests use fixture service and no real Muse credits. Original video report did not contain verbatim Muse reply; exact service-side reason for no video remains unconfirmed.
